senses.gloss:
रह् रह् (for original रध्), i. 1, and i. 10, रहय, Par. To quit, to leave.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रहित.
 1. Abandoned, Rām. 3, 52, 5.
 2. Deprived of, without, Rām. 1, 70, 35. [] n. Privacy; loc. sing. Privately, Chr. 37, 2.
 --With the prep. वि वि,
 1. To abandon, Rām. 3, 51, 17.
 2. With instr. To separate from, Vikr. d. 114. विरहित,
 1. Abandoned, left, Śiś. 9, 75.
 2. Deprived of, without, Vikr. d. 33; Nal. 10, 23.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. λανθάνω, ἔλαθον, ἀλήθης, probably ἔρημος; Lat. latere (cf. रुधिर); also perhaps λόχος, λέχος (cf. रहस्); Lat. lectum, legere; Goth. ligan, lagjan; A.S. lecgan, licgan.

रहस् रह् + अस्,
 I. n.
 1. Secrecy, Pañc. 253, 25; Chr. 5, 6; Vikr. d. 51 (loc., secretly).
 2. A secret, Rājat. 5, 317; a religious or mystic truth.
 3. A place of privacy, a hiding-place, solitude, Daśak. in Chr. 181, 23; Lass. 55, 15.
 4. Copulation, Pañc. i. d. 197 (but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2366).
 5. A privity.
 II. adv. Secretly, privily, Pañc. 192, 23; Chr. 53, 22.
 --Cf. रक्.
रहःस्थ रहःस्थ, or रहस्थ रहस्थ, i. e. रहस्-स्थ, adj. Being alone, Pañc. 45, 24.

रहस्य रहस् + य,
 I. adj. Secret, Man. 11, 247; concealed, 4, 144; mysterious.
 II. n. A secret, Pañc. 129, 2; a mystery, Lass. 20, 20.
 III. f. या, The name of a river.
 --Comp.
रही रही, A substitute for रहस् before the derivatives of कृ and भू; cf. भू.

राहु राहु, i. e. रह् + उ, m.
 1. A Daitya to whom the eclipses are ascribed, Hit. i. d. 20, M.M.
 2. The ascending node.
 --Comp.
रहस्य- + व्रत रहस्य- + व्रत, n. the command of that mysterious power by which mystical weapons may be wielded.
